items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: I never knew why they called him Sweet Pea.

ctx.x: How did he get the name Sweet Pea. We all know how delicate he was and such a quiet young guy and had this beautiful smile on his face and stayed --
I never knew why they called him Sweet Pea.
I wonder did Duke give him that name or what.
